t: Latvia was proclaimed in Riga on 18 November 1918 and won its independence in a war against several enemies.
The Soviet Union occupied and annexed it in 1940, and Nazi Germany occupied it from 1941 to 1944.
Independence was restored in 1990–1991; Latvia joined the EU and NATO in 2004 and the eurozone in 2014.
dyk: The Minox, a famous miniature spy camera, was first made in 1938 at the state-owned VEF electrical works in Riga.
ev: The People's Council proclaims the Republic of Latvia on 18 November
A peace treaty with Soviet Russia recognises Latvian independence
The Satversme is adopted; Jānis Čakste becomes president
Kārlis Ulmanis suspends parliament and rules as an authoritarian leader
The Soviet Union occupies and annexes Latvia
The Supreme Council declares the restoration of independence on 4 May
Full independence is restored on 21 August
Latvia joins NATO and the European Union

f.founder: Kārlis Ulmanis and the People's Council
